//: Drive-speed-ceiling probe.  Holds full throttle and lets the motor run
//1: to whatever the powertrain map allows, so the shaft's terminal speed is
//2: an observable rather than an assertion.  Pair with either config:
//5: Wheelspin case.  The wheels break away almost immediately and
//6: spin far faster than the car moves, so this is the drive's
//7: speed ceiling with essentially no load on it.
//10: Grip case.  No wheelspin; the car simply accelerates until
//11: something stops it.  ev1sim has no top-speed limiter, so before
//12: the ceiling landed this ran to 231 mph and was still
//13: accelerating.  This is the run that shows what the ceiling
//14: changes and where the change begins.
//16: Neither needs the external electronics sim.  Analyse the CSV with
//17: scripts/motor_ceiling_report.py, which converts wheel speeds to shaft
//18: RPM through the differential and the driveline ratio.
name: wheelspin_ceiling_probe
